Metric: Weekly activation rate

Purpose: Track onboarding completion.

Definition: Accounts with an activation event during the Monday–Sunday UTC window divided by eligible accounts created during that same UTC window.

Activation event: event_name=activated.

Eligibility: Exclude accounts where test_account=true.

Grain: Account.

Reporting cadence and freshness: Available by 09:00 UTC each Monday.

Zero-denominator policy: Report undefined.

Result: Not calculated.
